intermediateReviewBefore.scope: Installed official Tasks; native vault writes, cache and DOM checkbox actions. Temporary settings restored; unique fixtures deleted; no Apple access.

regressionEvidence.comparisonScope: Before and after have different totals because conditional reopen/undo checks and review regressions were added. Individual test names identify the reproduced failures; failed assertions are not counted as separate bugs.

limitations: No real Apple Calendar read/write in this verification.
Finite recurrences yielding only one row and custom statuses still require the Tasks source editor.
Undo of a recurring change is conservatively blocked by other task changes in the same source note. Independent prose edits remain permitted when task rows stay intact.
Continuous action timing uses a short synthetic fixture, not a large-vault or long-duration benchmark.
UI geometry uses native-generated synthetic markup; no Windows/Linux/mobile native UI claim.

ownerAdoptionBefore.evidence_origin: Independent reviewer tool stdout from the original pre-fix Chrome run; complete trial rows were not retained on disk.

source_before_fix.description: Gesture tracked the original window and relied on old-window events or lostpointercapture for cleanup. No gesture-only migration MutationObserver or cross-window cancellation before the down guard was present.

ownerAdoptionBefore.repro: Native pointerdown on time rail; immediately adopt the picker parent into an iframe document before pointer capture activates; move and release only in the new document; then attempt the first new-window gesture.

unchanged_original_inputs.observed: 09:07 and 10:08 remained unchanged in both failure examples visible in the original tool stdout.

ownerAdoptionBefore.limitations: observer counts recorded in review but original rows not retained

ownerAdoptionAfter.repro: Native pointerdown; immediate DOM adoption before capture activation; pointerup only in the new document; first fresh gesture in that document.

performance.scenario: Deferred and overlapping refresh requests during a native timeline drop with an 80 ms delayed fixture write

visualReview: 15 minute selection uses true range height
visible first row label avoids sticky header
narrow week label displays two readable lines
light/dark task controls and time rail visually inspected
dragAudit.independentReview: Focused code review and 20 real Chrome adoption trials passed; no further actionable findings in narrow scope.
